messages:
Priya: Kickoff — we need final send cadence for the Silverlining benchmark webinar (May 12). Target segments: trial users who've called the API in last 30d; active startups (<$2k/mo); enterprise POCs. Draft below. Please confirm owners.
Noah: I'll own the startup segment. Can we do a 3-email flow? invite -> 48h reminder -> 4h final.
Tom: Landing page + SEO folks confirmed. Suggest we A/B subject line vs preview text.
Priya: Draft subject lines:
- "See Redwood's latency & cost results — live May 12"
- "Real-world benchmark: same latency, lower cost"
- "Benchmarks that changed how we route inference"
Noah: +1 for the first two. Prefer 1 for invites, 2 for reminders.
Jamie: SQL to pull startup cohort (marketingops can run):
```
select id, email from users where plan='startup' and last_api_call > now() - interval '30 days'
```
Can we get that by EOD?
MOPs-bot: query job #482 queued by @jamie; expected runtime 15s
Priya: Also metric tags: utm_campaign=silverlining_bench, utm_medium=email, content=invite_v1
Priya: CTA mapping: register -> webinar_reg; can't attend -> watch_on_demand -> watchlist drip
Marco: For enterprise list, exclude any account with a dedicated contract. I'll hand filtered list to @Sarah-sales.
Sarah-sales: Will do. Also can we craft an exec-focused subject: "Benchmark briefing for infra leaders"
Noah: Timeline: final copy by Tue 11:00, segment lists by Tue 15:00, build Wed morning, QA Wed afternoon, send Thu invite 10:00 PST.
Tom: Send windows: 10:00 PST for NA, 13:00 CET for EU. Stagger to match open times.
Jamie: Quick ask: include a 1–2 line benchmark highlight in the preview text — empirically lifts opens.
Priya: Suggested preview: "50% avg token cost reduction in real-world tests — register for details"
Noah: A/B config: test subjects across 2 variants, 15% each; control 10%. Keep audience size consistent per region.
Priya: Also need: email template variant for localized EU copy (legal -> data handling blurb). @Tom can you confirm translation support?
Tom: Yep — we'll add short localized snippet and legal link.
Priya: Reporting: primary KPIs = registrations, unique opens, webinar attendance rate, post-webinar watch rate. Pull a post-send snapshot at +72h.
Marco: Ops question: do we want a converted audience (attended or watched) to be flagged for a follow-up trial-credit offer?
Noah: Yes — convert -> add tag: silverlining_attended -> trigger 14-day trial-credit drip (growth owns).
Priya: Copy owners: invite + reminder -> me; landing page -> Tom; enterprise outreach -> Sarah-sales; list pulls -> Jamie.
Sarah-sales: Noted. I'll coordinate tailored outreach for enterprise POCs.
Priya: Thanks all — I'll consolidate the plan into a single doc and post the final send matrix tomorrow AM. :party_parrot:
Noah: Thanks! :thumbsup:
